ValidationRule.description: This validation rule will restrict the user from changing the status of the closed case.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c ), $UserRole.DeveloperName <> "Business_Admin", OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Confirmation_Of_Payee", AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Case_Group", OR( ISPICKVAL( Type , "Confirmation of Payee Opt-In") , ISPICKVAL( Type , "Confirmation of Payee Opt-Out") ) ) ), ISCHANGED(Status), OR( ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( Status ), "Closed"), ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE( Status ), "Withdrawn") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Cannot change the status of case that are already closed or withdrawn.
